meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一个 WhatsApp 渠道：从 channels 分支复制原生 Baileys 适配器和格式化技能、注册适配器、装固定版本依赖、构建并跑注册测试，再用二维码或配对码把手机 WhatsApp 链接为设备。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 支持 WhatsApp 时触发。安装或认证前会先问这个号是专用号还是你的日常号；选日常号会先显示账号可能被封的风险警告，需明确确认才继续。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 渠道加到 NanoClaw
say.note: 先问用哪个号码，再安装并链接
终端显示二维码，手机扫码即可

say.text: 就用我的日常号，继续吧
say.note: 会先弹账号被封风险的警告

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude adds a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw: it copies the native Baileys adapter and formatting skill from the channels branch, registers it, installs pinned packages, builds and runs the registration test, then links your phone by QR or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want NanoClaw to support WhatsApp. Before install or auth it asks if the number is dedicated or your everyday one; a shared number shows an account-risk warning first.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Asks which number to use, then installs and links

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: A QR appears in the terminal to scan
Shows the account-ban risk warning first
